summary: Tested enhanced gamification features: Public leaderboard, period filtering, my-position, badge sharing, social media buttons, and click tracking with geo data. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend leaderboard page and badge modal with social share buttons verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing admin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: All gamification features working. Public leaderboard at /api/affiliates/leaderboard with period filtering (weekly/monthly/all_time). My-position endpoint at /api/affiliates/leaderboard/my-position returns rank, neighbors, and referrals_to_next_rank. Badge sharing at /api/affiliates/badge-share/{badge_id} returns share_text for twitter/linkedin/facebook/whatsapp. Frontend leaderboard page at /affiliate/leaderboard shows stats, period filters, and ranked partners. Badge modal shows social share icons when clicking earned badges in Performance tab.

features_verified.public_leaderboard_api: WORKING - /api/affiliates/leaderboard returns period, period_label, leaderboard entries with rank/name/tier/referrals, and stats
features_verified.my_position_api: WORKING - /api/affiliates/leaderboard/my-position returns your_position (rank/total/referrals/percentile), above_you, below_you, referrals_to_next_rank
features_verified.badge_share_api: WORKING - /api/affiliates/badge-share/{badge_id} returns badge info, partner_name, share_text (twitter/linkedin/facebook/whatsapp), share_url, image_url
features_verified.badge_share_validation: WORKING - Returns 403 for unearned badges, 404 for invalid badge IDs
features_verified.click_tracking_geo: WORKING - /api/affiliates/track/{code} records clicks with geo data from ip-api.com
features_verified.new_badge_types: WORKING - consistent_performer and quick_starter badges are defined in the 10 available badges
features_verified.leaderboard_page_ui: WORKING - /affiliate/leaderboard shows title, stats cards, period filter buttons, leaderboard table with rank/partner/tier/referrals
features_verified.badge_modal_social_sharing: WORKING - Clicking earned badge opens modal with badge icon, name, description, requirement, and 4 social share icons (Twitter/LinkedIn/Facebook/WhatsApp)

frontend_tests_passed: Leaderboard stats cards show Total Partners, Active Partners, Total Referrals
Period filter buttons (This Week, This Month, All Time) are visible and clickable
Leaderboard table shows Rank, Partner, Tier, Referrals columns
CTA for non-partners shows 'Apply Now' button
Badge modal opens when clicking earned badge
Badge modal shows badge icon, name, description, requirement
Badge modal shows 'Share your achievement' with 4 social icons (Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp)
Close button in badge modal works
